description: This file defines API routes for managing 'teams' in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for creating a team, listing teams with pagination, retrieving team details, and adding members to a team. The file uses SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions and depends on external services for authentication and domain logic.

classes.description: Schema for creating a new team.

classes.name: TeamDetail
classes.description: Detailed information about a team, including members.

classes.name: TeamMemberAdd

classes.name: TeamMemberOut
classes.description: Schema representing team member information returned in responses.

classes.name: TeamOut
classes.description: Schema representing minimal team info returned in lists.
